Prompt section
Quick tasks, familiar operations, when you want speed over ceremony
Streaming ReAct loop: think → act → observe → repeat until done; ends on the first plain-text answer
Full CORE toolset exposed; aggressive tool use encouraged — one correct action beats a long explanation
None by design — high-risk tools still gated by the permission system (first-use confirm)
\"## Mode: BUILD\" — act directly, keep working autonomously
Multi-step tasks, risky chains, when you want to review and reorder steps before anything runs
Plan (read-only, no tools) → your confirmation with per-step checkboxes & reorder → topological lock → execute in locked order → read-only reflection
None during planning (explicit read-only prompt section); full CORE set during execution; dependsOn cycles fall back to declared order
Plan confirmation card: enable/disable steps, move up/down, execute or cancel; after locking, the plan is immutable
\"## Mode: PLAN\" + \"## Planning Phase (READ-ONLY)\" while planning
Deliverable-driven work: docs, refactors, anything where \"what counts as done\" must be agreed up front
Spec (goal / requirements / constraints / acceptance criteria / deliverables) → your confirmation → each deliverable runs its own build loop → summary
None during spec generation; every execution step carries the full spec as context so scope is respected
Spec confirmation card: approve the contract or abort before any tool runs
\"## Mode: SPEC\" — output the spec JSON only, do not execute yet
Code generation, writing, any output where quality beats latency; tune rounds in Settings → Agent
Draft (streamed) → review (critique card) → revise ×N rounds (N = Reflection Rounds, 1–3) → final answer
Same CORE toolset as Build; review/revise passes are LLM-only (no extra tool risk)
You read the review card between passes; rounds are configurable, not interactive
\"## Mode: REFLECTION\" — aim for completeness, correctness, clarity
Ambiguous intents, multiple targets/apps/files, irreversible choices — whenever guessing wrong is expensive
Build loop + automatic decision-point detection: if the answer text lays out \"option A vs option B…\" a choice menu pops automatically; your pick is fed back as the next instruction
Full CORE toolset; the model is also instructed to call ask_user_choice proactively — detection is the safety net for when it doesn\'t
Every detected decision point pauses execution until you choose (or the 5-minute timeout falls back to the draft)
\"## Mode: HUMAN_ASSIST\" — never guess when the choice materially changes the result
Reusable behaviors: translator, code reviewer, brainstormer, rigorous scientist — or your own presets
Build loop with the selected preset\'s instruction appended — identical engine, different persona
Same as Build; the preset may add tool-usage constraints of its own (e.g. reviewer reads before judging)
Preset management: Settings → Agent → Custom Mode Presets (built-ins locked, duplicate to customize)
\"## Mode: CUSTOM\" + \"## Custom Instructions\" = the selected preset\'s instruction
